items.title: How OrderServ achieved up to 64% cost savings with multi-tenant ECS
items.summary: See how Cognizant and AWS Professional Services transformed the OrderServ food-ordering platform into a multi-tenant SaaS offering on shared Amazon ECS, cutting compute costs up to 64%, reducing scaling time from minutes to seconds, and lowering authentication costs by 80%.
items.creator: Chetan Yewale
